players.product: PLC-based AWG chips and AWG mux/demux for data-center optical transceivers, plus telecom DWDM AWG modules

quarterly_data.signal: Diversification outside optical components in H1 2026 (first consolidated statements): the company acquired 100% of Live Connection (performance and event planning and production; acquired 2026.06.11) and, through newly established software subsidiary Quantum AI Solution, 100% of Game Club (software development; 2026.06.22). After the period, Quantum AI Solution's shareholders resolved on July 9, 2026 to absorb Game Club, with a planned merger date of August 19, 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: 100% of Live Connection (2026.06.11) and Game Club (2026.06.22)
